name: before-stop: the agents are not named
find: still at work, and may be editing this tree (${named.join("; ")}).
replace: still at work, and may be editing this tree.
test: pnpm vitest run kit/hooks/hooks.test.mts -t "names every agent still at work"

name: before-stop: only the first agent is named
test: pnpm vitest run kit/hooks/hooks.test.mts -t "names every agent still at work"

name: before-stop: the next stop is not mentioned
find: `It runs at the next stop, once ${agents.length === 1 ? "it has" : "they have"} finished.`,
test: pnpm vitest run kit/hooks/hooks.test.mts -t "while a subagent is running, and says so"

name: before-stop: a long description is not cut
test: pnpm vitest run kit/hooks/hooks.test.mts -t "cuts a long description"

name: before-stop: one agent at work does not hold the gate back
test: pnpm vitest run kit/hooks/hooks.test.mts -t "while a subagent is running, and says so"

name: before-stop: the deferral also records the tree as green
test: pnpm vitest run kit/hooks/hooks.test.mts -t "keeps no record of a tree it did not judge"

name: before-stop: the command still writes a block
replace: const reply = answer ? `${JSON.stringify({ decision: "block", reason: answer.reason ?? answer.systemMessage })}\n` : "";
test: pnpm vitest run kit/hooks/hooks.test.mts -t "answers with a message and no decision when run as a command"
